QF.id: AIFM CIII Legal Documents and Negotiations_18

question.text: Which of the following PPM sections' audit is OPTIONAL (not mandatory) under SEBI's PPM-compliance audit regime?

answer.text: Investment Strategy and Class of Units
Fund Flow in Purchase and Sale of Securities
Risk Factors; Legal, Regulatory and Tax Considerations; Track Record of First Time Managers; Illustration of Fees and Expenses; Glossary and Terms
Governance Framework for Insider Trading and AML

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.5.2: 'audit of sections of PPM relating to Risk Factors, Legal, Regulatory and Tax Considerations, Track Record of First Time Managers, Illustration of Fees and Expenses and Glossary and Terms shall be optional.' Everything else is mandatory. The Trap: Options A, B, D are Cat III-critical mandatory audit items. The optional list specifically covers descriptive and legal-narrative sections where external-auditor value-add is limited. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests this exact list. XIX-D similarly tests the mandatory vs optional split for Cat I/II. Manager's Pro-Tip: Even though Risk Factors' audit is optional, Cat III managers typically include it — leverage-risk, side-pocket, and VaR-limit disclosures are fact-specific and well worth internal-audit sign-off.
